On a freezing December night in 1997, President Bill Clinton noticed a homeless veteran outside the Kennedy Center holding a sign reading, “Marine. Desert Storm. When the veteran revealed he had not eaten for two days, Clinton arranged for food and stayed until he finished. The story reminds us that compassion, dignity, and a simple human connection can restore hope when someone feels forgotten.

And all three could have a major impact on how financial markets trade for the rest of 2026 and into 2027.
